notes: Strip d: x 5220-6590 plus ~300 px overlap (4920-6890). Burnet Avenue runs N-S at centre x~5793 from Forest to the plate bottom; Harvey Avenue N-S at x~6700 from Rockdale south; Alaska Avenue N-S at x~6088 north of Forest. Suffixes: Hickory and Maple carry ST. only far east of Harvey (x~7400 and ~7850); Prospect PL. at x~8700; Ridgeway AVE. at x~7700; Rockdale AVE. at x~4300; Forest AVENUE at x~8700. Maple Street is narrow (~25 ft) and its line rises ~35 px from Burnet to Harvey. Elland Avenue: the diagonal is printed ELLAND north of Bethesda; south of Bethesda it is printed only AVE. and runs SE then east to Burnet (assumed to be Elland throughout). The loop printed ELLAND (north leg) ... CIRCLE (south leg) is recorded as Elland Circle; large spaced letters inside the loop block are a subdivision name, not the street. Elland Circle's north-leg junction with Elland Avenue (~4660, 5300) and Albany/Elland (~4600, 4870) lie west of the overlap and are not picked. Spaced letters ROBT YOUNG'S, ANDREW, HARVEY'S, JAS. A. CORRY'S, E. McNAMARA'S, SPENCER, BURCKHARDT'S, RENZENHAUSEN'S are subdivision names. No streets cross the Jas. Wall's / Forest Glenn Realty lands north of Forest between x 4920 and Burnet.
